header.title: Talking to your partner and family
header.subtitle: Gentle guides and words you can use. You decide what to share, and with whom.

guide.useLabel: Put this phrase in your message
guide.counsellor: A counsellor can help with this conversation too. They can join a session with your family if you'd like.

checkin.title: How are you feeling about all this?
checkin.subtitle: Private to you. It helps us offer the right support.
checkin.ok: Glad you're here. Take things at your own pace.
checkin.supportBody: You don't have to work through this alone. A counsellor can talk it through with you, and with your family if you'd like.
checkin.saveError: We couldn't save that, but you can carry on.

drafter.title: Draft a message together
drafter.subtitle: Ask GeneBridge helps you word it. Nothing is sent without you.
drafter.rewritten: Reworded. Check it still says what you mean.
drafter.templateNote: We used the guide's suggested wording. Edit it to make it your own.
drafter.rateLimited: You've reworded a lot in the last hour. Please try again a little later.
drafter.error: We couldn't reword that just now. Your message is unchanged.
drafter.saved: Draft saved. Only you can see it.
drafter.saveError: We couldn't save the draft. It's still here on this device.
drafter.sendNote: GeneBridge never sends this for you. WhatsApp opens with your message, and you choose who gets it.

privacy.title: Before you share this
privacy.named: This message mentions {who}'s result. Do you have their permission to share it?
privacy.someone: This message mentions someone else's result. Do you have their permission to share it?
